POSIX shell wrapper supplies an extensionless shebang cargo shim; native Windows executable resolution searches cargo.exe and can bypass this shim.
Existing PowerShell wrapper compiles a native cargo.exe proxy and runs a sibling copy of wasm-pack.exe, matching Windows executable-directory search.
Proxy preserves OS-string arguments, adds --locked only to metadata when absent, delegates to resolved real Cargo, and propagates status.
PowerShell wrapper also appends --locked to wasm-pack build, restores PATH/custom environment in finally, and removes its temporary directory.
Source workflow has no CARGO override; parent confirmed failed job environment likewise had only CARGO_HOME, CARGO_INCREMENTAL and CARGO_TERM_COLOR.
Explicit CARGO environment is a potential proxy bypass edge; exact cargo_metadata 0.15.2 behavior was not fetched, so this remains an unverified non-CI caveat.
PowerShell wrapper does not synchronize Studio public files itself; Desktop build:frontend separately consumes root pkg through copy-wasm.
